phases.feasibility: For each framework serially: one C64 x 1088 service run, preserve all WAVs, then complete WER/SIM. All three must have valid complete outputs and complete scoring before matrix.
phases.matrix: Subsequent separately approved continuation: C1/2/4/8/16/32/64 x 3 repetitions, one server per framework configuration for all 21 groups, all WAVs and full quality. This initial runner executes feasibility only.

objective: Descriptive latest-source comparison; framework implementation/configuration is the comparison variable. Success means complete valid measurements and full scores, not an optimization improvement.
continuation: No throughput or quality-score threshold filters comparison. Slower performance or worse WER/SIM is reported. Request failure, missing/corrupt audio, incomplete scoring, source drift or observed foreign selected-GPU process stops; no automatic config change/retry/optimization.
quality_reporting: Use fixed historical scorer/assets on every unfiltered request. Report WER and SIM versus same-concurrency vLLM; previously accepted +1 percentage point WER and -2 SIM are reporting bounds, not continuation thresholds.

benchmark.warmup: max(8, concurrency) before each concurrency; omitted from measured groups
benchmark.connection: fresh TCP per request, no automatic retries
benchmark.reference_codes: same 1088 preencoded references; no extra reference warmup
benchmark.audio: complete mono PCM16 at 44100 Hz; one frame = 2048 samples
benchmark.tail: All requests/full drain included. No trimming, length matching, output filtering or EOS speculation.

metrics.ttfa_p50_p95: linear-interpolated percentiles of dispatch-to-first received audio chunk

comparison_scope: Latest frozen source on existing final-path environments, not latest rebuilt dependencies. Same workload/client/GPU/CPU affinity; native framework capacity, scheduler and codec differences remain explicit. No equal-output-length or identical RNG schedule claim.

framework_differences.standalone: Historical 28-flag control profile plus row reuse disabled, native FP8 top8, GDN BF16; not bare-command FP32 state default. Codec BF16 and private async capture/thread.
framework_differences.vllm: Latest fish_omni.yaml, max_num_seqs 128 in both stages, private MPS, chunked prefill/admission settings preserved, stateful FP16 codec. Existing distribution metadata version may name old editable revision; actual imported package/model/CLI paths point to the pinned new source. CPU import success does not prove GPU runtime compatibility.
framework_differences.sglang: Latest Drama3 config with max_running_requests 64; existing SGLang/FlashInfer dependencies, native FP16 window codec, defaults otherwise unchanged.

ownership: Only GPU6 UUID is monitored. Empty preflight; random inherited token + UID/PID/starttime identifies own descendants/private MPS daemons. Poll once/sec, stop on observed foreign/query error. Only own identities are signalled; private MPS quit requires explicit observed token-owned pipe/UUID. Never global MPS quit or signals to other GPUs.
measurement_limits: One-second process polling cannot exclude shorter interference. Generation sampling is not reset between groups; numerical quality and output lengths are measured, not assumed. Client does not expose native EOS reason. Preparation and readiness are separate from benchmark makespan.
